subject: Private/on-prem onboarding — environment prerequisites & credential rotation plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
To: Asha Rao <asha@bluepeak.health>, Infra Ops <infra-ops@bluepeak.health>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private/on-prem onboarding — environment prerequisites & credential rotation plan

Hi Asha / BluePeak infra team,

Thanks for the kick-off call this morning. As promised, attaching a concise checklist that covers the minimum prerequisites we need from your side to stand up the Redwood private deployment (VPC + on-prem connector). Top-level asks:

- Network: CIDR allocations, NAT/egress path, DNS delegation point, firewall allowlist for outbound control plane (list included in attachment).
- Identity & access: service account that can be scoped to the tenant, SSH bastion user list, and an initial set of admin SAs for onboarding.
- KMS/HSM: key ARN for encrypting at-rest model artifacts and a point of contact for key rotation policy.
- Telemetry: a reachable endpoint for metrics/traces and the firewall ports (TCP/UDP) we should expect.
- Evidence: prefer a redacted export of network flow rules and the public cert fingerprint for the customer-facing gateway.

We also discussed credential rotation: we recommend a 30-day rotation for any onboarding-scoped keys and immediate switch to automated short-lived tokens once the environment is commissioned. I've sketched a proposed rotation cadence in the attached PDF and included a simple KMS evidence template (xlsx) for your security team.

Action items for BluePeak: please confirm the requested CIDR ranges and share the network diagram (or update the attached placeholder) by EOD Wednesday so our infra team can reserve compute and plan the routing. If you prefer, Tom from Corp-Net can share the diagram directly.

I'll loop Kim and Priyom for the network/hardening follow-ups.

Thanks —
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: redwood-onprem-onboard-checklist-v1.3.pdf (pdf), bluepeak-network-diagram_v2.png (png), kms-evidence-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Date: 2026-11-01T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private/on-prem onboarding — environment prerequisites & credential rotation plan

Ben — thanks, got this. We can provide the CIDR ranges and an initial network diagram. A couple clarifications from our security team:

1) KMS: we use CloudKMS with a customer-managed key; rotation is currently quarterly. For onboarding we can provide a short-lived key grant scoped to Redwood for 45 days. Is that acceptable?
2) Bastion access: we require MFA for interactive ssh and will provide a jump host user list.
3) Audit retention: compliance needs audit logs retained for 2 years. Can Redwood consume/forward logs or do you prefer we keep the S3 bucket and provide signed exports on request?

Tom, can you attach the updated diagram and the public cert fingerprint?

Asha

Subject: Fwd: network diagram + cert fingerprint

Forwarding the diagram and cert fingerprint (see attachments). Notes:
- Diagram shows on-prem DMZ with NAT gateway to the cloud region (us-west-2) where Redwood will deploy the private control plane proxies.
- We will carve a /24 for tenant workloads; please confirm there are no overlapping prefixes with Redwood-hosted connectors.

On the KMS grant: 45 days works for onboarding, but security will expect automated rotation into a shorter-lived grant once we move to production.

Tom

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>

Date: 2026-11-02T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private/on-prem onboarding — environment prerequisites & credential rotation plan

Thanks for the diagram and the cert, Tom. Quick technical clarifications from the deployment team:

- Egress: we need outbound HTTPS to these endpoints: control.redwood.inference (443), metrics.redwood.inference (443), s3.amazonaws.com (443) for artifact fetch. If BluePeak uses an outbound proxy please confirm the TLS interception policy — we need transparent TLS to the control plane or a pinned cert for the proxy.
- BGP/Peering: we will not take customer BGP sessions; all traffic should traverse NAT/egress and be routed to the Redwood public control plane.
- Service accounts: please create an onboarding service account with role "redwood.onboard.admin" (limited to provisioning) and email it to us. We will rotate that account's credentials after initial provisioning.
- Rotation plan: proposed schedule attached in-line (also in the PDF):
  * Day 0–7: manual keys for emergency access only
  * Day 8–30: rotate to short-lived (12h) tokens issued by your STS for onboarding operations
  * Day 31+: automated rotation managed by Redwood (ephemeral certs + KMS grant exchange)

Can Kim or I get a copy of the audit export format so we can confirm ingestion schema?

PRIYOM

--
Priyom Das
Platform Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>

Date: 2026-11-03T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private/on-prem onboarding — environment prerequisites & credential rotation plan

Asha / BluePeak team — this is great, thank you for the quick turnaround. A few final operational items before we schedule day-zero provisioning:

- Please upload the redacted network flow rules and the audit export (CSV) to the Drive folder linked below. We'll validate ingestion and confirm mapping by EOD Friday.
- For the KMS grant: 45 days for onboarding is acceptable. Send the key ARN and the grant policy (we will capture evidence for SOC2).
- Access rotation: Redwood will implement the automated cadence described by Priyom. We will require at least one rotation test during onboarding (we'll coordinate a 10-minute maintenance window).
- Firewall allowlist: see the PDF for exact IPs. If BluePeak wants us to use a static egress IP for the first 30 days for firewall reasons we can provide one but note that static egress may increase cost for dedicated routing.

Next steps / owners:
- BluePeak (Asha / Tom): upload network flow export, provide key ARN, create onboarding service account (owner: Asha) — due 2026-11-05.
- Redwood (Priyom / Kimberly): validate artifacts, schedule rotation test, confirm provisioning window — target 2026-11-07.

Once we have the items above, we'll book a 60-minute day-zero with you for the commissioning steps.

Best,
Kim
